text: {"label":"Behavioral Pharmacology and Psychotropic Medication","definition":"Work on behavioral pharmacology as a discipline, covering its methods, training, and regulatory roles, and on how psychotropic and prescription medications affect problem behavior, assessment, and treatment in applied behavior analysis.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Unlike laboratory studies of specific drug effects on schedule performance or choice, general clinical behavior analysis, or intervention programs, this topic addresses the discipline itself and medication's role in applied treatment."}
